source.title: Hydraflow Rainfall Report, file SedgwickCoKS.IDF, project 07698_Detention.gpw, dated Thursday, Sep 4, 2008

assumptions: The table Hydraflow fitted this file from is not in the report; the printed 12-point table (itself computed from the coefficients and rounded) stands in for it. So the gate is that Pro-Flow's fit reproduces the printed table; B, D, E are shown against Hydraflow's for information only.

Intensity tolerance = 0.005 (printed to 0.01) + the largest change that rounding B, D and E to the printed 4 decimals can cause at these durations; Hydraflow evaluates unrounded coefficients (values computed from the printed ones fall on both sides of the printed table, so it is not truncation).
notes: Hydraflow's printed D values are multiples of 0.1 (observation, not a documented rule).
